reason: The inference identifying the group-laws external's u_delta with the first component of the inverse from 1.7.4 is unsupported. lem-stage1-approximate-group-laws says only that u_delta is the inverse of an unspecified 'polar map'; it does not state that this map is Pi_delta(U,H)=U bold-dot H on calU x B_delta^{calH}(J), nor even supply the typed two-component inverse whose first component could be compared. lem-stage1-polar-retraction proves that explicit Pi_delta has a unique inverse (u_delta,h_delta), but uniqueness applies only after the other candidate is shown to invert that same map with the same domain and codomain. None of the allowed definitions supplies this synchronization; def-approximate-unitary-space expressly reserves u,h only as partial notation. Thus adding the retraction dependency establishes existence of an explicit inverse but does not establish that the u_delta used by the group-laws conclusions is its first component, so those conclusions cannot validly be transferred to the root's u_delta.
